description: List iOffice reservations. Supports filtering by date range, space, or user.

endDate.description: Filter reservations ending on or before this date (ISO 8601)

startDate.description: Filter reservations starting on or after this date (ISO 8601)

view.description: Response shape. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns iOffice's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which iOffice fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs. "brief" returns one line per item — title — <ISO date or "no date"> — <status> — with "-- " note lines for an empty or partial page.

name: io_list_reservations
